verdict.rationale: HeyGen documents a REST API for creating videos, including a prompt-to-video endpoint (POST /v3/models/videos) and text-prompt video creation with avatar and voice control. Batch APIs with webhooks and an 'API key to your first video' quickstart indicate that jobs complete and their results reach the developer. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented status-polling or asset-download endpoint, a published OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of the submit-and-retrieve flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can submit a video generation job through a documented API and retrieve the finished asset

citations.quote: Prompt-to-video model `heygen-video-1` on POST /v3/models/videos: text or image to 5–30 s clips with turbo/quality enhancement
Create videos from a text prompt with full control over avatar, voice, style, and file inputs.
From API key to your first video in minutes
Batch APIs — up to 100 requests per call, webhooks included
